### New Integrations


- [Motion ELD](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/motion-eld-v2)


### Integration Updates


- [Green Light ELD](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/green-light-eld) and[Quantum ELD](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/quantum-eld) now support[Historical Vehicle Locations](https://docs.withterminal.com/models/vehicle-location)
- [Loop ELD](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/loop-eld) now supports[IFTA Vehicle Month](https://docs.withterminal.com/models/ifta-summary)
- [Zonar](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/zonar) now supports additional[Safety Events](https://docs.withterminal.com/models/safety-event) , including expanded crash and distraction event coverage
- [PeopleNet](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/people-net) now supports` total_fuel_consumption` and` engine_runtime` in[Vehicle Stat Logs](https://docs.withterminal.com/models/vehicle-stat-log)


### Dashboard Updates


- The[Terminal Dashboard](https://dashboard.withterminal.com/) now shows the Delete Connection action for eligible admin users and adds an organization switcher on the welcome page when a selected org has no application


### Consent Flow Updates


- Link now supports short links end-to-end: you can mint short links and send users to` term.new/{code}` , where Link resolves the stored onboarding parameters


### API Updates


- Added short link endpoints for minting and resolving Link short codes, including[POST /tsp/v1/link/short](https://docs.withterminal.com/api-reference/link/create-short-link)
- [DELETE /connections/current](https://docs.withterminal.com/api-reference/connections/delete-current-connection) is now publicly documented and available in generated API specs


### Documentation Updates


- Updated the[deleting connections guide](https://docs.withterminal.com/guides/deleting-connections) to reflect the fully released asynchronous deletion flow
